description: This file implements elliptic curve scalar multiplication methods using wNAF (windowed Non-Adjacent Form) for the BoringSSL/OpenSSL cryptographic library, including functions for computing wNAF representations, precomputations, and batch multiplication.

methods.name: ec_compute_wNAF
methods.description: Computes the windowed Non-Adjacent Form (wNAF) representation of a scalar for elliptic curve scalar multiplication.

methods.name: compute_precomp
methods.description: Precomputes odd multiples of a point for fast scalar multiplication.

methods.name: lookup_precomp
methods.description: Looks up a precomputed point corresponding to a digit, handling negative digits by inverting the point.

methods.name: ec_GFp_mont_mul_public_batch
methods.description: Performs batch elliptic curve scalar multiplication using wNAF representations for multiple points and scalars.
